vibe_rationale: Curated surf-film tour that turns coastal halls and cinemas into surf-culture nights in 26 towns; a strong core but a single scene.
fit_notes: Active, surf-adjacent audience with precedent from non-endemic brands (Patagonia, Red Bull, YETI, Sawmill Brewery); age is not published, so scored cautiously. It is a New Zealand tour, so an Australian brand would need an NZ-facing activation, but the partners page makes a content or supporting role realistic.
